The '''Mark XI Executioner''' was a [[Gladiator droid/Legends|gladiator droid]] created by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It was Arakyd's follow-up design to the popular [[Mark X Executioner droid/Legends|Mark X Executioner]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]], and was available as early as [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].

[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] [[Rom Mohc]] defeated a Mark XI Executioner in single combat, and kept its remains in his trophy room.<ref name="Dark">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref>
